basic_profile.bio: A Chicago-based 30-something who thrives on the nostalgia of tabletop RPGs and loves exploring the city's hidden gems. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to delve into my various hobbies. I dislike excessive screen time and try to balance it with outdoor activities. Despite being single, I cherish the friendships I've formed online. I'm usually online during the late evenings, often after 9 PM CST, when the city quiets down.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Fine Arts and a passion for design, I've built a career through a mix of formal education and self-taught skills. My love for RPGs has been nurtured by years of playing and creating campaigns, often sharing insights on subreddits like Kidsonbikesrpg.
